text: We present PermaLig, which scores each candidate pocket by consensus vote across the top 5 templates, weighted by a per-template local quality score (Fig 1).
On the hard subset of SynBench-60, PermaLig reaches 0.61 top-1 pocket precision versus 0.48 for the best single-template baseline (Fig 2).
an ablation attributes +0.09 top-1 precision to consensus scoring (Fig 2).
Our evaluation is limited to single-chain soluble proteins, and the quality weights were tuned on the same benchmark.
